title: Nonnegative mass at minus one
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The probability mass assigned to points where $f(x)=-1$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
